# CloseMovie

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Movies](BlitzBasic-Movies)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CloseMovie:Void movie:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `movie` | In | Int32 | required | A movie handle from OpenMovie. |

## Description

Closes a movie that [OpenMovie](OpenMovie) opened and frees what it used. A movie that should play again has to be closed and opened anew.

## Differences

* Nothing , the same as the original. The picture and sound stop.
* A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the movie is closed already, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks). The 0 of a movie that failed to open is an error too.
